## Accepted partial result, attempt 1/5

Problem 10300018 / AMR-102-0018, rank 1248, Calegari Question 7.3 attributed to Dunfield. The universal boundary-slope algorithm remains unresolved by this work. No novelty or current-openness certification is claimed.

The full authored proof and mathematical audit establish exact decision for finite rational-affine point constraints on shared increasing interval homeomorphisms, rational PL interpolation, finite regular-itinerary compatibility and exact bounded homology output. Domain/range bounds, endpoints, inverse coherence, strict sectors, global variables and repeated edge maps are explicit. A suspension construction proves that finite periodic samples do not impose an all-closed boundary. A separate full proof decides F^q(x)=x+p for a supplied rational PL global return lift, with its section, peripheral basis, chosen lift, primitive pair and q>0 hypotheses intact.

Global realization, full carrying, essentiality and the selected boundary condition remain separate. No all-lamination completeness or rationalization theorem, global suspension extraction, arbitrary-length bound or unrestricted termination theorem is supplied. The precise corrected source comparison preserves Zung's geometric meridian and warns that the full-carrying, precise-carrier and global-essentiality hypotheses have not been completely identified with Lackenby's setting. The boundary difference is not asserted to be the only difference. Finite periodic diagrams are not advertised as a subset of Lackenby's carried slopes.

## Exact publication boundary and review limits

Only six authored proof/audit/status and public-source-metadata files are added under `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/10300018/`. All full mathematical proofs, authored examples, source credit and geometric/output-convention limitations remain. Programs, whole computational sections, computational results, machine-generated certificates, fixtures, datasets, copied source bodies, private artifact identities and private coordination are excluded. No excluded computation is recast as prose.

This edition is AI-assisted and unrefereed. Scoped acceptance is not external human peer review, journal acceptance or formal proof-assistant certification. Public source metadata records historical retrieval and inspection, including Zung's inspected v1 preprint status. Edition preparation makes no new scholarly retrieval, PDF rehash, source inspection or literature-search claim.

QUEUE.md and unrelated entries remain unchanged. Editorial preparation adds no substantive proof turn and does not reset attempt 1/5. No merge, release, DOI or outside outreach is requested.

Base commit: `f6caddda8f8be2cdb3e91494325d8f7f365bc3fc`.
